case.name: dsh-web-ui release-age / skin loader mismatch
case.claim: Replay only: the checked-in profile facts mirror the versions and patch rows described by the public issues; no plugin or DSH process is started.

findings.summary: pnpm can silently hold a DSH plugin below its newest release
findings.detail: pnpm-workspace.yaml sets minimumReleaseAge=14400, but these profile bundles are not excluded: @linxin666/dsh-web-ui-all, @linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skin-center. A newly published fix can therefore be unavailable during the cooling window, leaving the profile on an older broken layout.
findings.remediation: Either pin and review the intended versions, or add the exact plugin package names to minimumReleaseAgeExclude and re-run this check after updating the lockfile.

findings.summary: loader ui-skin-qq98 imports a package that is not in the profile
findings.detail: cordis.patch.yml:3 names @linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skin-qq98, but @linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skin-qq98 is absent from the locked dependency graph. DSH will fail when it imports this loader; adding the package separately can create a second registration for the same id.
findings.remediation: Align the patch with the installed bundle layout: remove this insert when the feature is bundled, or add the exact package to the profile and ensure it is registered only once.

findings.summary: loader id ui-skin-qq98 appears more than once
findings.detail: cordis.patch.yml:3, node_modules/@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skin-qq98/cordis.patch.yml:2 all contribute an active row. At least one is an insert, so DSH may reject the profile with a duplicate loader entry or load the wrong implementation.
findings.remediation: Keep one active registration for ui-skin-qq98; if the row is already supplied by a bundle, remove the generated insert instead of installing another package.

findings.summary: pnpm can silently hold a DSH plugin below its newest release
findings.detail: pnpm-workspace.yaml sets minimumReleaseAge=14400, but these profile bundles are not excluded: @linxin666/dsh-web-ui-all, @linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skin-center, @linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skin-qq98. A newly published fix can therefore be unavailable during the cooling window, leaving the profile on an older broken layout.
findings.remediation: Either pin and review the intended versions, or add the exact plugin package names to minimumReleaseAgeExclude and re-run this check after updating the lockfile.
